item.title: The Balanced Woman Blueprint: Wellness Reset for Women 40+ — Sat Sep 26, 10:00 AM — the Space
item.description:
RESET is a two-hour wellness experience designed for women 40+ who are ready to stop running on autopilot and start making intentional decisions about what comes next.
Saturday, September 26, 10am – 12noon, $45 Get clear about what you want. Make bold decisions about what comes next. Leave with a practical plan to reclaim your life. You’ve spent years showing up for your career, your family, your relationships, and the people who depend on you. You’re capable. You’re responsible. You get things done. But somewhere along the way, you may have become the last person on your own list. And maybe you’re asking yourself:
What do I actually want now? What needs to change? What do I want this next chapter to look like? Led by Sakirat Oladiran, NP, Board-Certified Nurse Practitioner and Certified Life & Health Coach, RESET combines guided reflection, meditation, meaningful conversation, and practical exercises to help you step back, get clear, and create a plan for moving forward. item.description:
Tuesday Night Figure Drawing – Open Studio *Cover art by Ling Chen.
Tuesday night at The Space is your invitation to drop in, find your creative flow, and practice your drawing skills. Each week a different nude model serves as our muse as we pursue creative expression through observation and mark making. We challenge how we see and what we want to say — observing the nuances of the human form, its moods, character, and light — and do our best to capture something in the moment that tells a story. This has become a tight-knit, supportive community of seekers — artists, experimenters, and curious souls drawn together by the shared pursuit of capturing the living human form. Use the time to refine your skills, experiment with different media, and deepen your understanding of anatomy, gesture, and proportion. item.title: Mindful Masculinity: A Circle of Brotherhood — Wed Sep 30, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description:
We Meet Bi-Weekly, Every Other Wednesday · 7:00 – 8:30 PM · $15 Through open dialogue, mindfulness, and other calming practices, we quiet the mind, open the heart, and deepen our connection to ourselves and each other. The circle is open to all male identifying individuals. Meetings are hosted by Leo A. Sante – mindfulness coach, teacher, and dad. We start by sharing our wins and challenges, honoring each voice without judgment or advice. From there, we move into practices that help us release stress, shift perspective, and bring awareness and resilience into our lives. Each week centers on a different theme to help guide us – trust, accomplishment, family, rest, intimacy, presence – as we discover new ways to move through the world as mindful men. Come as you are. Leave more grounded, connected, and inspired. Connect with Leo: Instagram: @holdingpresence Online: HoldingPresence.com Email: pe***********@***il.com

item.title: LINES TO LOVE: Screen-Free Afternoon with Your Child — Sat Oct 3, 1:00 PM — The Space
item.description:
Lines to Love: A Creative Space for You & Your Child. Led by Leo A. Sante Remember what it felt like to simply be together with the child you love?
No screens, no rush, no expectations.
Just being side by side, doodling, making up stories, letting your imaginations wander wherever they wanted to go. Lines to Love brings you back to that space. Using a simple roll of paper and a few drawing materials, you and your child will be guided into a playful world of co-creation. Together, you’ll follow lines, add to each other’s doodles, build whimsical stories, and let the drawing become a pathway to imagination. Lines to Love is inspired by a cherished ritual between a father, Leo, and his young son, Lucas. Back when Lucas was little, Leo would just roll out paper and two pens. Together they’d spend hours just doodling, creating, and enjoying the precious time together. Both Leo and Lucas cherish those drawings and those moments to this day. item.title: Exploring Hispanic & Afro-Caribbean Genealogy — Sat Oct 3, 2:00 PM — West Orange - Community Room 1
item.description:
About the program
If you are just starting out on your path through family history, this interactive and informative lecture, Introduction to Hispanic Genealogy, is perfect for you. This approach, spearheaded by genealogist Irisneri Alicea Flores, streamlines the research process while shedding light on the cultural and historical background of Puerto Rican and Hispanic descent more generally.
By following a four-step process, participants will be able to organize their existing knowledge, conduct interviews with family members, locate relevant family records, and set specific research objectives for their genealogical study. Using online genealogical platforms and historical documents can overwhelm beginners, but this presentation will help them manage their emotions and avoid repeating mistakes.

item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Oct 7, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream
